messages.author: 17d9c7a6e1a581b8
messages.subject: PyStan 0.2.0 released
parts:
PyStan 0.2.0 is up on the Python Package Index

https://pypi.python.org/pypi/pystan

Changes
-------

- fit.optimizing(...) method works for scalar, vector, and matrix parameters
- stanfit objects now have a ``summary`` and ``__str__`` methods � la RStan
- stan source updated to commit cc82d51d492d26f754fd56efe22a99191c80217b (July 26, 2013)
- IPython-relevant bug fixes

Useful links:

- Source code repo: https://github.com/ariddell/pystan
- HTML documentation: http://pystan.readthedocs.org
- Issue tracker: https://github.com/ariddell/pystan/issues
